source_note: Pairs synthetic F 5100.31 application forms with existing real label image groups from testdata/ (cataloged in manifest.json, WBS 2.1). WBS 2.3 sets (testdata/build_good_sets.py, set_id prefix 'good_') are 'good' (all-fields-match) sets, one per product type: form field values were chosen to match what is printed on each product's label images, so every Sec. 2.5 Parameter Comparison Matrix rule resolves to MATCH (or NOT_APPLICABLE where the form field is intentionally blank for that product type) and the expected pipeline outcome is APPROVE. WBS 2.4 sets (testdata/build_hard_failure_sets.py, set_id prefix 'hf_') are 'hard failure' sets, one per Sec. 2.5 comparison rule: each takes a WBS 2.3 'good' baseline and changes exactly ONE field so that exactly one rule resolves to HARD_FAILURE (every other rule remains MATCH/NOT_APPLICABLE as in the baseline) and the expected pipeline outcome is DENY. WBS 2.5 sets (testdata/build_allowable_revision_sets.py, set_id prefix 'ar_') are 'possible allowable revision' sets: each takes a WBS 2.3 'good' baseline and changes exactly ONE field so that exactly one rule resolves to POSSIBLE_ALLOWABLE with a populated section_v_ref (every other rule remains MATCH/NOT_APPLICABLE as in the baseline) and the expected pipeline outcome is RECOMMEND_EXEMPTION_REVIEW. Of the WBS 2.5 row's three named examples, two are covered by dedicated sets: case/punctuation/spacing brand-name differences (Sec. V item 3b, ar_brandname_fortemasso) and in-state applicant-address changes (Sec. V item 19, ar_address_barrilito). The third example, 'color/font differences' (Sec. V items 3a/3b -- also FR-057's literal test case, 'only label colors differ'), describes a label-appearance attribute with no corresponding field on Form F 5100.31, so it cannot be expressed as a form-value-vs-label-value comparison row in this schema; see DevLog.md Sec. 2.5/2.6 outcome notes for this scoping decision. Comparison rule references are DevLog.md Sec. 2.5; allowable-revision references are Sec. 2.6; application type references are Sec. 2.4.
